1928, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 28 Cont. July 11 Geo. Nestor away 2 yrs.
Page 29 July 12th Charles A. Thompson (n.cath.) 33 of 132 Balfour Road, afflicted with "Adisen" 2 cases found in U.S. Doctors - Specialists, etc expect his death before Sunday. Now in Ann Arbor Hospital. Has wife and 4 small children at home.
July 18 Convert Has Sleeping Sickness - Alex H. Smith, 40 of 4472 Field Ave. Sleeping Sickness 8 years - Wife and 4 children - Smiles but very shaky
Rita Loraine LaNoue, 4 - 10 convulsions in a day - Battle Creek Clara Stubba (41) 4466 Field, blind since last December, offers $25. for Poor Souls
Sick Mother Anna Gendron 50 of Escanaba, Mich. now in Ann Arbor, crippled foot since a little girl, operation has not helped ......
Baby Alvin Crough, 10 mo. - 335 Puritan Ave .- Enrolled about 7 weeks ago; then having as many as 6 convulsions daily - no more convulsions. Enrolled perpet. To-day to speed recovery.
Page 30
Mrs. Marie Bradley (31) 10976 Chelsea, rushed to St. Mary's Hosp. 12;30 P.M. for operation obstruct. of bowels. She was expected to die in two hours. Mother came and enrolled her in S.M.A. and asked for prayers. This evening Saturday, July 21th she comes with Mother to say she had no operation !!!! Deo Gr.
July 22 Michael Sullivan 53, Hubbell, Mich. - cancer of Stomach or adhesions of bowels ... pray
Paula Kurth
Genevieve Hurley - Bay City
Page 31 August 1st
July 27 Mrs. Eliz. Lucier (58) of 1927 Delaware Ave. has inward Goitre and "puss kidney" down to about 80 1bs. Enrolled this A.M. two years.
